_comment: Curated llama.cpp arguments for specific models, matched by the GGUF general.basename (case-insensitive). Juiced adds them at launch unless the model's saved arguments set the same flag or the operator turns Juiced defaults off. Add a recipe only with a measurement behind it.

recipes.reason: N-gram drafting doubles decode speed when the model repeats code it has seen (file rewrites: 22.8 to 48.9 tok/s on a Radeon 890M) and leaves chat speed unchanged.
